_sheet: The deck. One row = one card. Name, flavour, rarity, colour theme, art motif and effects all live here; Generated/CardTable.cs gets one CardDef per row. PLACEHOLDER rows are temporary until the real card list is added.

_columns.id: stable small integer sent over the network (1-255); never reuse
_columns.name: card name shown on the card
_columns.flavor: short italic line under the effects
_columns.rarity: common | uncommon | rare (draw weight from rarityWeights)
_columns.unique: true = a player can hold this card only once
_columns.effects: stat id -> value; every key must be a stats.json id; flags use true
